correctness.rationale: Minimum-norm affine moment constraints give w_i=1/m+(1/2-z)(X_i-z)/S and W^2=1/m+(1/2-z)^2/S almost surely. Under W>t the residual norm is <|z-1/2|/sqrt(t^2-1/m); rescaling and bounded-continuous rho yield the exact t^{-(m-1)} constant by dominated convergence. Positivity follows from a continuous nontrivial density away from 1/2. Layer cake gives the sharp p<m-1 cutoff and independent noise variance sigma^2W^2 gives m=4 MSE threshold. All statements concern unconstrained weights, zero-integrand measurement noise, bounded continuous densities, fixed Lebesgue target.
